sentence_stem: If the company had invested in training last year,
correct_completion: it would be far more competitive today.
full_sentence: If the company had invested in training last year, it would be far more competitive today.
acceptable_variants: it would probably be much stronger in the market now.
it would have a much larger share of the market today.

options.text: it will be far more competitive tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: Tomorrow is a future time. A mixed conditional needs a present-time result that follows from the unreal past condition.

options.text: it has invested in training every year.
options.why_wrong: This is a real fact, not the hypothetical result of an unreal past condition.

options.text: it was far more competitive last year.
options.why_wrong: This gives a past result, which does not match the present-time consequence that the stem requires.

options.text: it would be far more competitive today.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: third-conditional condition (had invested) with second-conditional result (would be)
explanation: A mixed conditional links an unreal past condition to an unreal present result. Here 'had invested' sets up the past condition, and 'would be ... today' gives its present consequence.
translation: Якби компанія минулого року інвестувала в навчання персоналу, сьогодні вона була б значно конкурентоспроможнішою.
